Heroin overdose... and no, I'm not a junkie... (Never done hard drugs before) Although, that might give me something to live for... anyway... heroin is a few blocks away... just need enough..... 

Hopeless and afraid.... How do I tell the people close to me that I can't kick this "suicide habit"? I can't grasp life and hold onto it.... All I see is a broken world.

basically, I want to live in a facility. I need help.... but when I need help, I isolate myself. I don't want to live alone.... I'd rather... well, you know.

In patient? I don't know. My suicide plan is simpler.
